items.description: Report does not state whether the router holds a nonzero ETH/ERC20 balance at the time of a direct call, so the balance-read subject cannot be tied to a concrete nonzero amount.
Report does not state whether the router holds a nonzero balance at the time of a direct call, so the amount-level relation between router balance and injected balance cannot be quantified.
Report does not specify the target contract or calldata used in the direct call, so the concrete injected-balance flow is not defined.

Report states the drain as potential and gives no observable amount or balance relation; the direct-call guard absence is the root cause, not the selected impact, so the drain is encoded as a grounded Boolean outcome rather than a numeric balance relation.
